ext.marketplaceBuiltinNotice: Knox is built into KnoxCoder; you can uninstall the marketplace extension.
ext.desktopOnly: Knox is desktop-only and does not run in vscode-web (no browser entry; sqlite and PTY are Node addons).
ext.remoteNativeMissing: Knox native addons missing on this host ({{addons}}). Over Remote-SSH they must exist on the remote (sqlite3, ripgrep; node-pty is optional).
